verification_report.summary: The proof is correct. The finite flag-ideal/GAGA argument identifies the rational PL lattices on common algebraic models, and equality of analytic and algebraic nefness on the smooth projective central-fibre components identifies the two rational PL positive cones. The MP-to-BJ inclusion correctly verifies generic finiteness at the trivial valuation before applying decreasing closure; the reverse inclusion follows from BJ's ample-class regularization by H^dom(alpha) and the MP decreasing-net definition. The DXZ comparison used in the last step is a comparison of the full psh cones on all semivaluations and imposes no finite-energy condition. All cited statements, their definitions, hypotheses, and downstream applications match the primary sources. No critical errors or gaps were found.
